mentions.name: Marasi
mentions.description: Open source application security testing proxy with a Lua extension system. A recent update adds modules for use during testing (encoding, encryption, request/response manipulation) and lets extensions extend the application's GUI: since the proxy is a library and the GUI is a separate application, the GUI injects its specific render and update methods to bridge the two.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've just pushed a big update to the Lua extension system in Marasi (an open source application security testing proxy).
